metadata.title: Internet Society Foundation | The Internet transforms lives
metadata.summary: The Internet Society Foundation focuses on funding initiatives that strengthen the Internet in function and reach so that it can effectively serve all people. Find out more about our work.

We fund initiatives to build an Internet for everyone.
Explore Our Funding Areas
Photo by SOLE Colombia
The Internet Society Foundation exists to support the positive difference the Internet can make to people everywhere. It promotes the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people's lives, and a force for good in society.
Learn More
Open Opportunities
Supporting inspirational work by people who believe in the power of the Internet.
Internet Governance Forum Events
Supports the organization of United Nations (UN) IGF Secretariat-recognized National and Regional Initiatives (NRIs) and National and Regional Schools on Internet Governance.
Find Out More and Apply
Beyond the Net Grant Program
Supports Internet Society chapters in implementing innovative projects that make a local impact by providing meaningful access to an open, trusted, and globally connected Internet, as well as strengthening the chapters’ presence in their surrounding communities.
Find Out More and Apply
Research Grant Program
Supports global research collaborations that advance understanding of the Internet and its value for all.
Find Out More and Apply
